reviews.title: It’s good
reviews.comment: So far the past weeks to a month I’ve had it no problem or issues. The quality is nice for the price I’ve paid and sounds and materials are superb and work right out of the box.
reviews.author: Ronald

reviews.title: Greatest keyboard for the money with rgb functionality and easy interface with iCue software
reviews.comment: Greatest keyboard for the money with rgb functionality and easy interface with iCue software. I was very impressed at the layout of the extra buttons to the left of the main key area. I bought this brand specifically due to the PC components I have running my RGB functions in the case. I was greeted with the bonus feature of the "G" keys to the left being able to program macros through stream deck app by Elgato. Who wouldn't want a nice tactile feel with each key press and added benefit of the full keyboard buttons for when the gaming takes the back seat and you need to get some work done?
reviews.author: James Crawford

reviews.title: Great keyboard. Nice sound without being too loud.
reviews.comment: Great quality keyboard that is a substitute to a mechanical. The keystrokes are precise and quiet. Has a nice sound that isn't too loud. The keys are actually quite satisfying to use.
reviews.author: C.
